items.title: 7.3.2 Impacts of the Digital Divide (Roman Urdu)

blocks.text: Digital divide ke impacts (asar) aam logon aur poori society (muashre) par door tak jate hain. Yeh asar pehle se chali aa rahi inequality (na-barabari) ko aur barha (exacerbate) sakte hain aur nayi na-barabari bhi paida kar sakte hain. Agle hisson mein paanch asar hain: taleem, economy (paisa aur rozgar), social aur civic participation, sehat aur digital literacy.

blocks.prompt: Digital divide pehle se chali aa rahi na-barabari ko kyun barha deta hai?
blocks.explanation: Jo log pehle se peeche hain (kam aamdani, dehaati ilaqe) wohi online taleem, naukriyon aur sarkari services se bhi mehroom (khaali haath) rehte hain, is liye woh access (pohanch) rakhne walon se aur peeche reh jate hain.

items: Digital divide purani na-barabari barhata aur nayi paida karta hai: taleem, economy, civic participation, sehat, digital literacy.
